prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.3 °C (65% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.9 °C (49% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.2 °C (56% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.67 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.30 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 799 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.5 % (48% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
